Rest.Title: Rest
Rest.BlockingNote: Hungry, Thirsty, Sleepy, and Cold block recovery of their linked attributes during this rest.
Rest.LongDescription: Restores 1 point in each damaged attribute that is not blocked by conditions.
Rest.HeatSource: There is a heat source. Clear Cold at the end of the rest.
Rest.LongConditionRemoval: Sleepy is cleared by sleep. Cold is cleared only with a heat source. These conditions still block recovery during this Long Rest.
Rest.ShortDescription: Characters can perform extended actions. Once per Quarter Day, one attribute may recover 1 point if an appropriate consumable or condition is used.
Rest.ShortAlreadyUsed: Short Rest recovery has already been used this Quarter Day: {attribute}.
Rest.ShortAvailable: Short Rest recovery is available this Quarter Day.
Rest.ResetShortQuarter: Reset the Short Rest limit for a new Quarter Day
Rest.ShortManualConsumableNote: The module does not spend consumables automatically: food, water, smoking supplies, conversations, drugs, and potions can be represented in different ways. It records the recovery and writes the selected justification to the result.

Rest.ShortNoDamageError: The selected attribute does not need recovery.
Rest.NoChanges: Rest completed with no character-sheet changes.
Rest.ResetNotAllowed: Only the GM can reset the Short Rest limit.
Rest.StartsNewDay: This rest starts a new day

FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.Intro: {actor} wakes and feels the call of {condition}...
FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.EnduranceRequired: No craving die is rolled. Make an Endurance roll. Failure causes a relapse.
FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.Controlled: The craving is controlled. No Endurance roll is required today. Remember to advance the cycle.
FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.Relapse:
{actor} gives in to {condition} and takes a dose.
The addiction cycle returns to its beginning (decline: d12).
FBLEC.Chat.Heat.Check0: An Endurance roll is normally not required.
FBLEC.Chat.Heat.Check1: An Endurance roll is normally not required, but another hot quarter day becomes dangerous.
FBLEC.Chat.Heat.Check2: Make an Endurance roll at the end of a hot quarter day. Failure increases Heat by 1.
FBLEC.Chat.Heat.Check3: Make an Endurance roll at the end of every hot quarter day. Failure deals 1 Strength damage.
FBLEC.Chat.Heat.Check4: Make an Endurance roll. Failure deals 1 Strength damage and 1 Wits damage.
FBLEC.Chat.Mor.BecamePermanent: Rolled 1. The point becomes permanent. Mor: {current}/{permanent}.
FBLEC.Heat.Level0.Label: Normal
FBLEC.Heat.Level0.Summary: The temperature is tolerable. There is no mechanical effect.
FBLEC.Heat.Level0.Consequence: Heat deals no damage. Travel can continue normally.
FBLEC.Heat.Level1.Label: Warming
FBLEC.Heat.Level1.Summary: The character is warming up. The next hot quarter day is dangerous.
FBLEC.Heat.Level1.Consequence: There is no penalty. Resting in shade with water removes 1 Heat point.
FBLEC.Heat.Level2.Label: Overheating
FBLEC.Heat.Level2.Summary: -1 to Endurance and Move while the character remains in the heat.
FBLEC.Heat.Level2.Consequence: At the end of each hot quarter day, make an Endurance roll. Failure increases Heat by 1.
FBLEC.Heat.Level3.Label: Heat exhaustion
FBLEC.Heat.Level3.Summary: On reaching this level, the character suffers 1 Strength damage.
FBLEC.Heat.Level3.Consequence: Each further hot quarter day requires Endurance. Failure deals another 1 Strength damage.
FBLEC.Heat.Level4.Label: Heat stroke
FBLEC.Heat.Level4.Summary: A failed Endurance roll deals 1 Strength damage and 1 Wits damage.
FBLEC.Heat.Level4.Consequence: Daytime travel without water, shade, or magic carries severe risk.
FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.ControlledAutomatic: The craving is controlled. No Endurance roll is required today; the addiction cycle advances automatically.
FBLEC.Chat.Addiction.ControlledCured: The craving is controlled. The addiction cycle advances automatically and the condition is cured.
